name: Bhawani Mandi–Ramganj Mandi District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 2201, Bhawani Mandi–Ramganj Mandi District road, crosses the border between Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Rajasthan PWD and MP PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
